name: PETRONAS Carigali and Shell Malaysia EOR program, Baram Delta (Sarawak) and North Sabah PSCs, offshore Malaysia
description: HOA aims to lift production by 90,000-100,000 boe/d across the Baram Delta and North Sabah fields, raising average recovery factor from 36% to 50% and extending field life beyond 2040; technology deployed at North Sabah flagged as possibly the world's first field-scale offshore chemical EOR process

sources.note: Offshore magazine, PETRONAS, Shell consider first-ever field-scale chemical EOR offshore Malaysia, 11 November 2011 (status as of that source; read 28 October 2026)
